text: We shared a blueberry lemon poundcake that very moist and tasty. Huge selection of baked goods! Everything looked amazing. Very friendly staff even though they were busy.
Slow, bad customer service. I had to wait an hour for a family meal. I gave it a star because I had to, but 0  is what they deserve

Had one of the best charbroiled oysters made even better by the customer service we received from Sidney at the oyster bar. He was friendly & very knowledgeable about the menu and gave us some very useful information about the areas too. 

I will be back for the raw oysters and happy hour specials.

We loved this place. I advise getting there early if you don't want to wait because it gets crowded. They don't take reservations but they do have a wait list- Yelp will tell you how long the wait is and will remind you when to put your name on the list in order to eat at a specific time. The pizza was really good- crispy crust snd delicious toppings - I ate a whole 12 inch pie by myself. The servers were very attentive- we had a young child with us and they made sure she was taken care of. We are from NY so can't come here often but next time we're in town, we'll be back.

I finished my review 20 minutes ago! Posted it as well!!! I Love The Grill! 
I posted a very nice review wherein I raved about the food, the service the great people running the kitchen and on and on.
 Yum!
C Medina

Me and my kids did every Sunday to Pueblo Real in Franklin.  Tito's in Berry Farms and now Nolensville food is same which is awesome.  Bartender rocks on the margarita. Noticed the management knew a lot of the customers.  This location will rock.  .

I travel all thru Ga Tn Ala this was hands down the best Bbq I have ever had do yourself a favor and go if you are in town had the bbq potato it was delicious will be going back tomorrow for lunch to try the tacos.
This is our first experience at the Black Bear  diner and it was amazing! Felicia was the best server ever!! Kudos to you girrrl

Customer service was approved average and staff all complied with Covid-19 guidelines. Variety of breakfast options along with vegan / vegetarian selections. Chicken was moist and Apple fritter was tasty.  Vegan chicken was very good!

I was hungry and felt like having a good eggplant. They advertised the farm eggplant parmigiana so I asked about it and they said it was good, that they used Panko to bread it. My disappointment was that I couldn't find the eggplant, it was almost all Panko. I need to say that the waiter was very cordial and offered to change it, but it was late and I refused. I don't think I'm going back there.
This place is the best! Beautiful. Gorgeous building, people, and great delicious food!

Did pickup order
Everything was as ordered and delicious 
Just the right amount of spice and very flavorful.
Authentic with some unique entrees.

I've eaten here several times over the years and it has always been good.  I had my typical Greek lunch of a gyro on pita with a (huge) side Greed salad with anchovies.  As usual, it was very tasty and filling.  The service was good and the prices reasonable.

Like the Terminator, I'll be back.

This place is great. I'm not a big whiskey guy myself, but some of my coworkers are so we checked it out the other night. The atmosphere is great. Our server was Katie, she was really fun and made some great suggestions. She got me to try a couple whiskey cocktails which turned out to be really good, I would come back just for the drinks. Katie also suggested the goat cheese fondue which was killer. Oh, and the whiskey cake was incredible. I will say there seemed to be more people working there than there were customers, but I'd guess that's the newness of the place, I guess they've only been open a couple weeks. But we had a great experience and I'll definitely be back. Planning to bring my girl next time for date night!

Ordered one pizza and a soda through the grubhub app. It never came. 4 separate drivers went to the place to pick it up. They never made our food. I tried to call underpins times but no answer. Don't order form this place.
I would highly recommend! They have indoor and outdoor seating, great environment, great food, nice staff and awesome milkshakes! There is a candy shop inside as well.

Do not come here for there chilequiles, it's definitely on my top worst places to get that dish. The price was ridiculous paid $15 for a soda and the chilequiles, i wouldn't have mind if they were actually good. The wait was horrible too, i felt like they just forgot about my order and very quickly just put my order together at the last minute. I probably waited there for half an hour, no joke, i saw people order after me and they got their food first than me. When I took it home I was disappointed, way too much salsa, very little cheese, and it seemed like they scrambled up some eggs and put it just on top. Couldn't even finish my plate, overall it was a pretty bad experience.

If you're looking for a good breakfast place, look no further. This place is AMAZING. Authentic french food for a great prize. I would highly recommend eating a croissant, they are made in-house and are the best croissant I have ever had.
Great service and fantastic view. Didn't know this place existed. It's tucked away at the end of Rocky Point. Will definitely be back!
Have been here plenty of times for lunch. Food is always good. Service is fast and food comes out hot. Stop in and try them for lunch. You won't be disappointed.
This little place is wildly overpriced.  The pasta fagiole  soup was extremely salty and acidic.  The prices are much higher than competitors.
Picked up food and drove home about 15 min away. Burgers were still warm, fries crispy, great onion rings. Large portions! Will return
EVERYTHING is well priced and tastes delish. The friendly and helpful staff helped this non spanish speaking guy out a lot. I will be back... weekly!
Was recommended this Gem by some friends.  Everything was delicious and fresh. Will be our regular Thai spot.

My third time eating here. Everything I have had so far was great. If you like chicken sandwiches, the Chicken Deluxe was the best chicken sandwich I have ever had. It's BIG. It's messy. It's delicious. Fat guy certified.

This restaurant goes on DoorDash and other good delivery platforms as Nashville hot chicken shack, not being too many Nashville hot chicken places in Tucson I decided to give them a try due to the pictures they have on the platform that looks like authentic Nashville hot chicken... I was skeptic but decided that it couldn't be that bad.. I was dead wrong the chicken sandwiches we received were nothing like the picture.. Popeyes chicken sandwich is 1000x better and cheaper, also I asked for Hot and I couldn't taste a trace of spicy ness, my girlfriend got normal heat and the chicken was the same level of spicyness, we paid $34 dollars for two sandwiches a side of fries and no drink.. what these people are doing is false advertising, I threw that shit away because I am not gonna waste my meal on mediocre less than mediocre food, I was better off getting a spicy chicken from McDonald's not even blowing it out of proportion.  On DoorDash it doesn't say that claim jumper is the one that makes these sandwiches but after putting my order checking the address it was coming from and calling to confirm the employee at claim jumper confirmed they made it, even recommended it as good Nashville's hot chicken and when I called back to complain he stated that he never had real Nashville hot chicken lol..

Reilly's is always a great choice. They have a lot to choose from but of course I always go for the pizza. Whether you like brussel sprouts or not, you have to try them here. 

We Reilly's so much that during the Coronavirus we decided to make sure they stayed open by purchasing gift cards for future visits. 

This is a great spot to bring out-of-town guests or just for grabbing a bite to eat with coworkers. I've never been disappointed.

I normally love Alderto's but take out is often a mess. I wish they would use better containers. Here's what my order looked like when I got home. Sauce leaked in the bag. I'm lucky my seats are still clean. Their flimsy containers are not designed for this!

I had to come here because family was having a wedding here. Unfortunately, the staff here is extremely in accommodating. In situations requiring early check in, usually the hotel staff will at least CHECK if there is a possibility for early check in. This is especially important for weddings because sometimes the ceremony starts not long after check in time. I've been in tiny hotels before where they'll usually swing some sort of accommodation in these situations. Here, they couldn't care less. When you call to request early check in, the answer is automatically no. They don't ask your name, they don't check the system or even ask a date. After 20 minutes of asking 5 different ways, they claim there is some sort of "wait list" you've got to get on (why didn't they mention that 20 minutes ago?) but that they'll leave a message for a manager and he will call you back. You wait several days during which it becomes too late to actually cancel. You call the manager Brian and leave a voicemail, but he never calls you back.

Came in because of rave reviews. I love coffee I cream and will automatically order whatever the store's best version. Theirs did not have the full coffee flavor I had in other places. My husband was not impressed with his either.

Got
The newk Q and it was delish. Hubby is vegan and was able to enjoy a
Veggie sandwich (no cheese, no mayo). Will
Be back very soon.

I am originally from New York City and used to eating amazing Brooklyn pizza. At the moment because of the pandemic I am down in lutes Florida staying over at my brothers different choices to eat. But I always have a soft spot for pizza. I ordered a spinach half pepperoni the small was actually pretty big not that expensive. I wound up eating  my sons half. because the spinach  they use was amazing very tasty soft next time when I order I am gonna  ask extra crispy besides that I give  it an eight out of 10

I'm so glad to welcome Psomi Greek American Bakery & Eatery to the North Howard NoHo South Tampa neighborhood! I've been eyeing the construction of Psomi for quite some time in eager anticipation of its opening as I pass by the area often on my way from Soho to the interstate. It's a shame Psomi is only open until 3pm because they're closed most of the time I pass by in the evening and it's been a tough place to catch open. Psomi elevates the entire North Howard Avenue area with its brand new beautiful building and helps make North Howard no longer just an area you pass by on the way to the interstate. Psomi is located next to another new California style building, Clinical Research of West Florida, and is across the street from a recently renovated Bryan Glazer Family JCC Fitness Center.

Our server told us Psomi literally translates from Greek to "bread" but its essence refers to the best bite, the "choice" piece, the crumb that everyone at the table fights over. The Decor of the Psomi restaurant is very modern, open, and elegant with large slide out glass panels that extend the open air feel through the back patio and Greek wall art everywhere. However, unlike Acropolis Greek Taverna, off Kennedy, Psomi does not feature any live music, napkin throwing, or belly dancers. 

We came to Psomi for brunch on a Sunday and it was packed with an hour wait for good reason! Psomi is the new hot spot! Psomi's parking lot was full and 2 blocks of cars lined both sides of Cass street. L

Ate lunch with my family here, and it is a 10/10 service is super great and nice people. Great sushi, they never disappoint. If your on the edge of eating at this place don't be this is one of the better sushi places in the area.

yum yum yum yum yum 

I absolutely LOVE the perch because it satisfies my sweet tooth every time. Two words: Nutella Crepes. I get this every time because they're consistently amazing and gigantic. I also get a side of scrambled eggs which also comes with its own side of mixed greens so it's kind of like an ongoing Russian nesting doll surprise but with breakfast food. For such a small space they do a pretty great job of feng shui-ing the inside to not be super cramped which I give them props for. Every time I've gone it's been near opening so I've never witnessed a crowd or stood in line (thanks Obama). Overall I always have a pleasant experience here and I'm pretty happy I live close enough to get my Nutella fix on the way to work. The Perch - you're doing amazing sweetie.

The service is very below par.. I've been waiting for my chorizo tacos for 20 minutes while my friend has been eating theirs.. the service is very slow and they seem to not really know what they are doing.. I've been sitting here waiting for my server and she is no where to be found.. I am very upset and they don't really care how to treat a customer.. very sad.. I come here every weekend and it's the same deal.. I don't think I will be back.. would never recommend this place to family and friends.. the food is ok nothing special you can get these tacos  anywhere even a gas station.. they need to work on communication skills and customer service skills along with manners!

My friend loves Pho. I'm not a big fan of it, but I do enjoy other Vietnamese dishes. I got the combination Vermicelli bowl. It was my first time so I wasn't expecting my noodles and veggies to be cold. I asked for it warmed up, but I still felt like it was missing something. The waitress offered to bring me a tray of sauces to try from but none of them were tasty to me. So, I asked if I could get a side of beef pho broth and she brought it right out. Omg! This took it to the next level. I then added some sriracha and I was in love. I know that was a lot for on bowl of food, but my waitress was super understanding and wanted to do everything to make sure I enjoyed my food. My friend got the Filet Mignon pho which was really good too. That's what made me ask for the beef broth. The meat was tender and they serve it with lots of noodles. Lots of noodles are always a plus! The restaurant itself is super clean and the staff was amazing. Will defiantly be back.
The hotel  rooms are tiny,  and uncomfortable. The shower  floor is slippery,  with nothing to hold on to. The staff is uninformed,  and unhelpful. Would never stay here again.
my favorite seafood place! they never let me down! from seafood to poboys! everything is evergthing this place is literally my second home

Was recommended by a friend to try so we did. My friend bragged about the portion sizes and great prices but this was so far from what we experienced. 

To start with my wife had the spaghetti and meatballs which was $16. It came to the table 5 minutes later and was a small bowl of pasta and 2 medium sized meatballs. The meatballs were good and that's the reason for 2 stars instead of 1. She did not even get a piece of bread or a side. We actually thought they mistakenly brought her the appetizer portion but the confirmed it was the entree. 

I ordered the seafood stuffed avocado which was $20. The menu said the avocado was stuffed with crabmeat so I thought the price was reasonable. Well it came and the avocado was stuffed with tuna and shrimp salad. I could not detect any crabmeat. If it was in there it was totally overpowered by the tuna and spices. 

We were out of the restaurant in 20 minutes so that tells me all the product is precooked and ready to serve. 

Too many good restaurants in this area to settle for this. Don't think they'll be around long if this the typical.

I am in love with these cheesesteaks!! I love how they chop the meat very fine and the roll is fresh and soft. I also like that they use sharp provolone cheese... don't be a tourist and get whiz eww. All in all very good quality cheesesteak for a reasonable price
Liked it better than Chubby's across the street. Long line, but it moved fast and the food came out pretty quickly.

I came to Philly to try Genos and Pat's to see who was the king of ring. The winner on my book is Pats. However, I don't think they are the king of the steaks. Jim's Steaks are the king. I enjoyed every bite I took and i can't wait to go back @raulvsfood

Nothing better than a family friendly, small & cozy bar & grill atmosphere. The food is delicious. As many wing flavors as buffalo wild wings but MUCH better prices and bigger wings. Chicken strips are so good. REAL meaty chicken! My husband loves the burgers! Fried pickles and sweet corn bites are good too.  This place has quickly become one of our favorites. We haven't tried a bad item yet. Generous portions at good prices. Jeffersons is totally underrated in this area. More people should know about it. My only complaint is that they are not open Mondays. My mom always wants to go to the restaurant when she comes to visit on Mondays, and they are closed. :(

Decent, not great breakfast. Service was excellent though. The waiter, working the graveyard shift, was impressive the way he was hustling about and the manner in which he dealt with the numerous drunks. I'm an early riser, but was surrounded by people that hadn't turned in from the night before yet. Obviously these people took away from the ambieance, being a bit boisterious and obnoxious.
Food was amazing, especially the charbroiled clams! Not normally a fan of clams, but was recommended to this place by a friend and they says to get them, was not disappointed

Accidentally ordered from this one instead of the one the one on Los Altos Parkway.  Unfortunately, the pizza was way too much dough for my liking.  The dough was a bit mushy under the toppings.  Had to peel some bread off.  The toppings were plentiful and good but the bread was not all that.

The best place to eat in Indiana. The service is amazing, the food is delicious. 

El mejor lugar para comer en Indiana, el restaurante es hermoso, la comida es deliciosa, el servicio es atento y muy cordial. Sin duda es el mejor restaurante de comida mexicana que en el estado.
Fresh produce, great service, excellent quality and value. This is the best meal I've had in Goleta!

Yummy yummy! I'm Gluten free and I miss sandwiches on Regular bread. Then I heard about Elsies Pickle sandwiches and cucumber rolls! Drove from North Jersey to try them. It was worth the drive.  Everything was fresh and the pickles were amazing, the best I've ever eaten.

I made reservations, required as of a few days ago. They canceled the reservation 15 minutes ahead of the reservation time. We did arrive a few minutes after our scheduled reservation time and fortunately they were able to seat us quickly. But not what if there wasn't seating? Why did they require a reservation and cancel it 15 minutes early? 

There were 7 and us and none of us really liked the food. It was bland and just wasn't very good. I am giving three stars for the customer service and because our waitress was also good at customer service. Tipped her more than the automatic gratuity for a large party. That's what you do for good customer service and when you know its not the server's fault. 

Manager KATIE MCHORSE at reservation/customer relations should get some hospitality training from these kind, responsive and professional women at Uno Mas.

A great coffee shop and lunch spot as well as a caring and inclusive business.  During COVID times they have done a wonderful job of protecting both their employees and customers.  We had a veggie burger and salad.  We enjoyed them on the patio.  If you order from the website you may need to create an account.

I still love this place, it is my all time favorite restaurant especially over other Mexican places. The owners and the whole staff are the friendliest people there are. They are very quick with service whether your eating in or carrying out, always attentive to drinks, chips and salsa whatever you may need. During the epidemic they stayed strong, stayed open for carryout thru the drive up window. Which was a blessing for faithful patrons like myself who needed their fix!! Don't waste your time looking for different places to go, come here, you will not be disappointed at all

To reserve a table, I put our name on the restaurant's Waitlist. We were seated immediately, and service was prompt and helpful.
       The pesci special was a bronzino fish, oven seared with the skin still on. The fish--served on a plate of roasted squash, cucumbers and tomatoes--would have been perfect. However, the whole plate was DROWNED in a fatty oil, making the vegetables extremely soggy. The lasagna and chicken picatta were passable, but as a rule all of the dishes were consistently salty. 
      Overall, we experienced good service, but mediocre food.

Be aware that you need reservations for the bar. I think because of the limited capacity they are using the bar for full service dining. We stopped in after 9:30, and  were told that the (many)  open seats were reserved . Plan accordingly-the days of "bar hopping" or stopping in for savory cocktails are done..

Great ambiance and friendly staff. The place needs a touch of music (after all this is New Orleans). 
The food is ok. Lovely presentation and good bread. However, the flavor is faded. The lack of oomph in flavor is evident in the appetizers all the way to the dessert; and perhaps  more pronounced in the latter. Finally, the wine collection has a few nice surprises in it and pairs well with the dishes.

Friendly staff! The sandwich was very tasty. The location is well maintained/kept clean. Dont have any negatives to say except the food's a bit pricey but that said the ingredients are fresh and with good quality so it's worth it.

Bartender was not friendly at all upon arrival. No greeting and he seemed bothered to have to step away from his conversation with another patron when we spoke to him. No music, just tv. This bar was recommended to us by another restaurant waiter, but unfortunately it wasn't worth the visit.
Great beer, great food, great people!  BBQ is on point, and get a flatbread and thank me later!

Had a dinner date with the wife on a Friday night. (12/04/20). Unfortunately they said the wait was 45 minutes to get inside. We were hungry so decided to brace the cold outdoor seating. Big mistake. It was right at 30 degrees and they sat us on steel lattice chairs away from the free standing heaters.  The wife was looking frosty in about 10 minutes. Luckily a couple left and we were able to move closer inside the outdoor lean-to three sided structure.  I reminded the Arctic staff that we weren't from California, but no no dice, stuck outside. We had cocktails that almost iced over before the food arrived.  The food was great and we endured the conditions without frost bite. Funny, in less than the 45 minutes, several groups showed up and the wait was less than 15 minutes. Be advised, hold off until spring unless you dress for cold and not a dinner date. 
I'm not giving access to my photo library, so no photos will be posted.
Wife,I and my son ate breakfast there and it was awsome food was great and waitress (from NY) was very nice gave us lots of info on area attractions
When you're high and hungry, those wings hit the spot. Crispy outside, moist inside. Never fails.

I initially had a problem with this Reno location a few months back. I reached out to the number they have posted on the wall and I received a fast and efficient response. I made time to report my issue then so now I am making time to say how I have seen such improvement in this location. Kudos to Ryan and his staff!!! Especially during this pandemic. The process that they currently have implemented in order to still serve while keeping the staff and customers safe is admirable. I order my family food through the Chick-fil-A mobile app. I love the curbside pickup option. Once I arrive I enter the number of my parking spot in the app and the staff is out within a decent wait time. I also love the new build your own family meal option on the app. It makes ordering super easy for my family. My only suggestion would be is to add a received order option to the app. I received two alerts from the app asking did I receive my food long after I returned home. Overall, I am pleased. Thank you all for keeping such positive spirits during this time. Thank you for your wonderful service and efficiency. God bless!

The only good thing about this spot is Lauren and the hostess. We've Waited for over two hours to get our delivery. But I guess I should mostly blame door dash. But still feel like more could have been done. We ordered at 8. It is now 10. We can no longer order from P.F. Chang's... and it's too late for dinner anyway...

But Lauren went above and beyond for us trying to contact drivers and door dash. Thank you Lauren. 

Tonight I go to bed with a sad,sad empty stomach. They did refund but it was such an inconvenience I wish management would have done a little bit more to compensate.

The owners of Pastiche, Costas and Judy, are among the kindest and most gracious restaurant owners we have ever met. They and their great staff are 'all about' relationships and go out of their way to make one feel welcome. Their offerings are outstanding with generous portions of both appetizers and entrees, all thoughtfully plated, consistent in high quality, yet quite reasonable in price. Their "specials" are excellent, usually consisting of at least one type of fish. Fish, meat and poultry are well represented on the menu and the steak au poivre is delicious. The restaurant has great big windows and give a lot of natural light which sets the stage for a very pleasant dining experience.  The bar area features a spacious U shaped bar, a plentiful selection of liquors, beer and a nice wine list. Happy Hour is well thought out and in addition,on Mondays, features half off the prices of whiskey and on Wednesdays prices are half off of full bottles of wine. TV's are available above the bar and are non-invasive. Pastiche is not at all stuffy, and one can feel comfortable to drop by and 'come as you are' to meet up with a friend, yet it still maintains an upscale atmosphere for that special evening out. Because of all of the above, we love Pastiche.

I ordered through Uber Eats the below items:
1. Fried Yuca with cilantro garlic sauce, spicy poyo-poyo sauce, chopped onion, fresh salsa, and pineapple rum sauce. 
The yuca was good but missing sauce. I did not receive the chopped onion.
2. Largo Tropichop with grilled chicken with brown rice & letters all the way. With cilantro garlic sauce, spicy poyo-poyo sauce, chopped onion, and fresh salsa. 
The food had a good flavor, but I am again missing the chopped onion. In addition, I ordered it with half brown rice and half lettuce. My order had mostly brown rice and very little lettuce.
3. Flan
I have not tried it yet but it was small. I thought I got the wrong size.
There was no utensils or napkins with my to-go order. The oder took over an hour to be made and delivered.

My  5 star review is for the awesome oyster po boy I just ordered from here. It's loaded with oysters and plenty of lettuce, mayo and tomato. That's the standard dressing so I added hot sauce and pickles. Excellent crusty roll with a soft interior perfect for absorbing all the ingredients. And the price is only $11.49, which is much lower than an oyster po boy from the more well-known establishments. For comparison I paid $16+ yesterday for a shrimp po boy at Domilise's. The oyster po boy at Adam's is far superior to Domilise's in terms of price and value! Definitely a hidden gem since it's located in a residential neighborhood a few minutes away from the Tulane campus as the roads are typical New Orleans (bumpy, uneven, narrow). Take out only.

First world problem: Well I wouldn't order from this place (location) in my life ever again even if I was starving to death. 
1. Delivery literally took 2 hours and that was after calling to check what was going on. The Pizza was ready and just sitting there. When the pizza arrived it was cold. 
2. They forgot to put Cheese on the Pizza. 

This owner doesn't care about his location and Papa Johns should revoke his franchise.

I would never, ever go back to Backspace Bar & Kitchen ever again. The server was very impatient, bordering on rude and the drinks were average at best. I ordered the Grown Up Grilled Cheese and specifically asked for no onions. Of course, upon taking a big bite, I discovered that there were onions in the sandwich. I then proceeded to gag violently. 

As mentioned previously, I would not return to this establishment and, given the server's attitude and the inaccuracy of my meal, I would recommend for others to stay away too.

When we arrived on the gulf coast, our first stop was Ybor City. Our first destination in Ybor City was Stone Soup. The Cuban Sandwich is award winning, so we wanted to try it for ourselves. We sat on the patio under a speaker buzzing with enjoyable tunes and drinking iced tea. The sandwiches themselves were quite ample and I loved that they were perfectly sized to dip into the soufflé cup of tangy mojo sauce.  I was also a fan of the kimchi side. It was a little less spicy and seemed like the brine had been maybe diluted a bit which made it seem almost like a slaw. 

This is my first trip to Florida and Stone Soup was a perfect introduction to the sunshine state!

My boyfriend and I live down the street so we have come to eat here probably 5 or 6 times. We have always been satisfied with our meal and the service every time. Today we came in for lunch and an elderly man fell outside the building. Both guests and the staff rushed to help him and the family. His granddaughter was very young and crying and one of the staff members pulled her to the side and was consoling her it was incredibly sweet. Thank you to the staff for going above and beyond I really think everyone there today deserves extra kudos!!

We had a fabulous dinner here. Made a rez online. Seated promptly. Our server was very attentive. I had the smashed watermelon marg - fabulous. We had the queso - it was good, kind of a "bougee" queso but still good. Chips and salsa were good. We all had tacos, I had the carne asada - fabulous. Definitely a hip, upper end mexican restaurant - so if you are looking for old fashioned trashy Mexican food (which I love too!!!) this isn't the spot. But highly recommend for this certain vibe. Will be back!

Bad and expensive. I ordered pizza ($21)and soup ($5) online, and than I come to the restaurant there is no host or anyone to route me to online orders pickup place. The pizza  was late. 15 min from appointed time and it was pale and six small slices of prosciutto for entire pizza. Then crash felt old and undercooked. The soup cup was very small for $5 and tasted like watered down marinara sauce.

We found this little gem on yelp and have been going ever since. The food is excellent. The waitress service is great and everyone enjoys their meals every time we go. Reasonably priced. You don't leave hungry!

This was our first time going to Momo's, and the only thing we regret is not trying it sooner! We ordered the chicken torta, taquitos, spanish rice and pinto beans. As you can see from the photo, it was so good we couldn't stop eating even though it was a huge amount of food for two people. Can't recommend this place enough!
Great specials.  Prime rib is pretty good.

Michael is our server he is awesome he is on top of his game the atmosphere was great!
The food was fresh and delicious! I love the spicy popcorn and the duck fries they are my favorite.
Yum-mayyyyy!
I'm not a big drinker, but my mocktail was outstanding!
Needed some time to chill with my husband and my son this was perfect!
Thanks so much "Mike" for making this a memorable night for us we appreciate it!
I've never been able to find or recreate a Sonoran hotdog like the ones in Tucson until I found Chile Y Limón! AMAZING!

Horrible service and so-so food.  The server didn't even take app plates away. We stacked our own plates and they stayed on table while we ate. And, the cocktail was horrible. Big mistake coming here.  Too many good places to eat in NOLA.  Why did I eat here? Group dinner. We made rezzies and it still took a very long time to be seated. Bottom line: skip this place.

Good prices and fresh ingredients make this fusion Mexican place a good bet if you are in the area.  You order at the counter and they bring it out.  Lots of seating (outdoors but covered) which is well maintained (as is the bathroom).  We got one of every vegetarian option on the menu and they were all good enough we'd gladly eat each one again.

I have eaten in this restaurant and had take twice from here.  I always get seafood boils.  The seafood sizes are big and it always seems fresh.  The corn in them is cooked perfectly.  I love this place!

It's hit or miss with this place but every experience I had at night time was always bad, so show for the day shift! I love hooters, but if it was another one in town I would definitely go to that one for a better experience!
A friend highly recommended and I'm kicking myself for waiting so long to finally make it in. I am dreaming about their pizzas. Must. Have. More.

First time visiting from out of state, first impression was that it looked really cool and getting into ran smoothly. The bathroom was pretty gross, you couldn't have paid me to clean it. With almost 10 stalls, at least 7 were left in a disgusting state. I let a staff member know and then went to the bathroom again and it was still gross. Then eating at their restaurant and we were sat within 20 minutes, had the chicken tenders to do the food and tokens deal. Games were fun, some of them took your money and didn't work. Didn't get the chance to bowl or do the "ropes" course.
BEST WINGS EVER!! 10/10 recommend! All the food is great and the employees are super kind!
A delicious stop on a long journey!  Tender pork, "I like that...it's nice flavor."  "This is really good".  Comments from our dinner party.  "This is the best thing I have ever eaten."
this is a great seafood restaurant. food is delicious and service is great in a very relaxed setting

Happy to say we finally got our act together last week and ordered 3 take out dinners from Drake's Place in Ferguson. We'd been talking about it for months, but kept getting sidetracked. I was wishing for brisket, so I ordered the Smoked House BBQ, since it comes with two meats and I have a hard time picking between brisket and pulled pork. Both of them were tender, moist and flavor-filled. I only wish I had remembered to ask for the sauce on the side. With bbq this good, I like to be more judicious with the sauce. My 2 sides were the Mac & Cheese (so creamy) and the Coleslaw. The coleslaw is the variety made with mayonnaise, which was a nice change from the vinegar version. One of my guests ordered the burger and said it was fantastic. My son ordered the chicken strips and fries along with the Summer Salad, and he loved them all. The salad itself was enormous and fresh. We all agreed we'll order from Drake's again, sooner rather than later. 
My son and his friend picked this order up for us and they both remarked on how very nice the people were who took care of them at the restaurant.

If you like bowling, don't miss the Tuesday specials : $2,00/person/game!!!! Enjoy!
Good time with friends bowling. They have over 30 lanes that you can enjoy. Recommended to book the lanes in advance to not have to wait over 1 hour.
They also have a room to follow sports on tv and order food. Food menu is basic and fried food overall. Our group tried various  appetizer and food, it was overall ok, but not fantastic. The service was pretty disappointing on that side : needed to ask 3 times to get silverware and was told our last round of drink would arrive before the closing time, but never did...
The bathroom cleanliness is also something they  should consider.
I love this place! Very homey and the staff always treats you like family. Food is amazing!

Arrived at Jenkintown location for 6:30 reservation to celebrate boyfriend's birthday on December10th.  Server was very gracious.  Waitress was at tentative and polite. Boyfriend requested sinew be removed from our strip steak.  It was not. And his steak was extremely fatty.  While the manager removed the charges from our bill, he walked away hungry.  He was very disappointed. Will never go back..

Perfect coffeehouse vibe, great for studying with lots of tables. They have a nice selection of coffees, milks and sandwiches. I got a caramel latte and it was absolutely delicious. The staff are super friendly and helpful.

Asked for a table for 3 outside. Open tables both inside and out.  I was told they are not pushing any more tables together but could sit inside.   Went around the corner and sat outside at Pizzeria Vetri.  Sat outside and had a better meal.
Love the feel of this place!  Got the surf and turf last week and it was incredible!  Looking forward to going back when I'm passing through Metairie again.

I'm still reeling from the wonderful Lobster Roll and Clam Chowder at Luke's. The taste sensation was a rich overload of fresh lobster and perfect seasoning. Clam Chowder was fresh and inviting to whisk me to a seaside in Maine... far away from the tattered streets of Philadelphia. I'm really happy to stumble upon such a nice restaurant.

Giving everyone the benefit of the doubt, with all that has been so unsettling, I am still, disappointed.  We called for takeout for a special occasion, having made the reservation the day before, and dinner wasn't ready.  Drove it home a couple miles, having paid 200. for three meals, and didn't have one meal that could be appreciated  between us.  Spouse got up and popped open a can of rolls from God knows why we have them, and enjoyed that more.  Speaking of which, no rolls?  A dab of Steak, a couple of potatoes and squash (with jalapeño?)  $33. later, our tongues are burnt and so is our wallet.  Bouillabaisse for two, four unopened clams, a couple scallops, mussels, fennel slices and unsalted broth had us staring at one another.  We couldn't stomach a forkful of tart between us.  -I'm so looking forward to getting back into weekend restaurant mode.  But I'm not convinced there is a reason to return here.  Too many places are very, very good in Philly.  Now I can't afford another choice this weekend.  And after brushing my teeth, can't get the heavy-handed garlic out of my mouth.  So sad.  Happy anniversary to me!
Hey.. Best fish tacos around. Completely awesome! Actually I love anything here. Please make this a destination if visiting or living in  Tucson. You won't be disappointed
Unbelievable food, great service and extremely friendly staff. Authentic Italian cuisine .

I will give this 4 stars instead of five just because of the service. Service is part of the experience. The food is delicious, the buckets are amazing, except the "garlic butter" (if you love butter bring your own) the crab cakes are delicious, the crab dip is wonderful,  drinks are great prices however, the service there is horrible. My mother was already waiting there and they would not seat her at a table until I got there yes we had a table for two but it was not busy and we had a reservation either way she was going to get a table it was a reservation for two not 20. I felt like she could've sat at a table. I came in and the bar is right there almost as soon as you walk in however there were four people behind the bar not one person acknowledged me and not one person asked did I need help or anything. they just continued their conversation I had to ask them, how weird is since I don't even work there. we were seated only after the person seating us finished their conversation. we sit down we order I get my drinks that's great then I want another drink but no waitress or waiter is around I had to go up to the bar to order my drink again I guess I work there. We had slaw but no for my mother asked for a fork one would assume since she asked for a for and I had the same thing as her I would need a fork but the waitress mustn't have thought about that. Sorry to drag on but customer service is important especially if you want a good tip. I'm talking to you lady with the blac

This place is ridiculously overpriced. I was charged $6 for a side of turkey bacon, which was two slices. The service was really bad and the food took a long time. The atmosphere isn't great, you're literally almost sitting on top of the people at the next table. I could barely get up from my table without knocking into the people next to us. Don't waste your money or time, so many better places in philly.
A+ real deal solid food. Walk up window and outdoor seating is perfect. Real people making great meals Look forward to my next time here. 100% must check it out if you have never been.

My sister and I arrived here 20 minutes before closing on Sunday, September 27. Three staff members, including a manager, were very rude upon our arrival. They were visibly upset and the manager completely ignored my sister when she greeted him. We've frequented other G&Bs in the Tampa Bay Area and this type of behavior from one of our favorite establishments is totally disappointing. We will not be visiting this location again. And even though they were rude, we still left them a tip because we felt bad for getting there 20 minutes before closing.

Came here for dinner on 7/5 and was not disappointed!! I love the crab legs here!  We sat outside upstairs and although the little bugs were annoying, we had an awesome view and waitress. She gave us tips on how to get the meat out of the crabs legs and omg I wish I would have been given those tips sooner!! Lol I wish I could remember her name because she was super nice and quick! The crab legs here are delicious and so is their drink. I forgot what it's called but it's their signature drink.

Easily top 5 Vietnamese in NOLA and no one outside of downtown knows who they are. Great modern style Pho, which is a nice change of pace from the traditional French Quarter dishes. 

Any of the spring rolls and the beef rice plate with fried egg are my usual go to dishes, but haven't had a bad selection yet. 

Super quick to get your food and they a built for downtown takeout. 

Would have given 5 stars but they don't have a website or social media so you have to resort to yelp menu photos and your best option is to just call it in. Oh well, the food is great!

The best 28" Extra cheese and pepperoni pizza i ever had. It reminded me of the 28" pizza slices i had back in 1961 at Tonys Pizzaria back in Brooklyn 12 NY when basic slices were $.15 and bottles of coke were $.10 plus $.05 deposit and they wouldn't give you your nickle back until you returned it. Sure miss those huge slices and cheap prices. At least you can still get those delicious huge slices plus unfortunately lots of inflation. Wow it reminds me of almost 60 years ago on my walk to PS 156 when Brooklyn and Pizza were great. Thirty cents went a long way back in the 60's. Today's Florida pizza usually is tiny and not enough cheese and rubbery or hard crust easily beaten by a good frozen pizza. This place is the exception. Everytime i'm near Brandon this is my go to spot for great PIZZA.
Love from Chicago, great high quality restaurant with great management. Love this place.

Amazing Toasted Ravioli, which was a given, but the Gnocchi Bolognese was a surprise hit. 
Wrapped up the meal with some of the best tiramisu I've ever had.
Great food, great service.

I've been to Lucky's a few times over this past year. Recently I went for dinner but was disappointed in the service, the cleanliness because the mirrors were smeared! Also the food was not served hot. I'm sorry but when willing to pay top dollar i expect the best service and a clean restaurant.
The food is awesome but Kelly was very rude and very disrespectful. She will cost them my business. What a shame.
This place is uh-Mazing! We're regulars now and I have to say Jamon is my all time fave chef. He's friendly, respectful and creates delicious meals!
AMAZING! So good! Food was perfect! Perfect for any meal. Had chicken and waffle sandwich and goat in the grove. Love this new place!

Ok I'm really torn with this review because even though the ice cream was good it was not worth it.  So after a nice dinner tonight my GF and I found a new ice cream place in Newtown Pa.  Ninas waffles.  We pull up to a separate building from Newtown village which was all wooden nice lighting and very cozy feeling.  We look at menu and could not figure it out.  After a tutoring session by a nice employee we learned how it works.  There are different ways to get a waffle however the menu shows waffles with topping but no ice cream.  We ended up getting a Shawn dream which is a waffle with caramel, peanut butter and cookie dough for $8.95.  If you want ice cream its an extra $2.75 a scoop which was small.  Since we were sharing, two scoops were ordered.  The dessert came out and the waffle was the size of eggo's and the scoops were small.  Plastic utensils were given and the knife had a hard time cutting through the waffle.  I then ordered a milkshake and the total bill was $24.00.  Ok now that I ranted there is one thing true.  The waffle and ice cream were excellent and the flavors came out right.  Maybe this place is a once a month treat or maybe its just Newtown prices.  But a $14 waffle and $9 shake is just not worth it.

My boyfriend and I have considered eating here a number of times and I'm so upset we waited so long. The woman who took our order was so sweet and helpful, I wish I had gotten her name. And the food was. so. good. I got a bowl with karage and pork belly and wow was it so good. My boyfriend also got the pork belly and we both are looking forward to eating here again! Definitely a unique spot for Tampa and we're so happy to have found it l.
Fantastic pizza and pasta. Christino's is my go to place when we visit my family back in Clearwater. Love their ravioli. I can not recommend them enough...well done.

After struggling to agree on where to go for a late Valentine's Day dinner, I let my partner decide where to eat and we ended up making a reservation here. I'll be the first to say that brazilian steakhouses were not my favorite. I've been to Rodizio and Fogo and I thought they were okay but not mindblowing. My experience here at Picanha was probably my first full 10/10 experience at a restaurant. The atmosphere is very chill. It was decorated very nicely, but not over the top where it felt TOO fancy. We got there at 5:30 with a reservation that felt unneeded because it was almost empty when we got there. But within the hour it quickly got packed so good thing we got there when we did. The service is what probably made me give the full 5 stars. Our server provided us with excellent service, he was very relaxed and chill, and always tended to our needs (even when we didn't know what we needed) it was the little things that made him stand out more than any other server I've had at other restaurants. He would come by often and offer a clean plate, fold our napkins when we left the table, and pour our wine glasses when it was looking a little too empty. Okay I ranted enough, now let's talk about FOOD. The buffet-styled appetizer bar? (i don't know what to call if i'm sorry i'm new to this LOL) had a lot of choices from salads to charcuterie, to pasta, chicken wings, sea food, mashed potatoes, and a bunch of other stuff I probably should have tried. I tend to not eat a lot from th

So for the 5th time in a row I have had a bad experience. My wife and I live within 5 minutes of this location and we try to do business here regularly because our 4 girls love the pizza and so do my wife and I. The taste is not where our problems lie. The problem with this location is that they always mess up our order. Not once, twice, or even three times. They've messed it up the past 5 visits to the location. They either get the toppings wrong or they just don't make my pizza at all and I am having to wait in the parking lot even longer. I really wish they could just get their act together because the pizzas here are the best tasting to our family and it's so close to our home. A little attention to detail and making sure the order ticket is correct would go a long way and make this location a great place!

You walk in and within moments are greeted by staff. A good looking establishment with great music playing - setting the tone. Bryce was over top the amazing, great customer service and made me feel at home  The bartender was amazing as well. . .Attentive and kind. I had the filet steak salad and it was so delicious! Definitely check this spot out
Used to go here a lot when it opened a few years ago, sad to say buisiness is good but food not as good.  The Greg Brady had plumeted into a soggy mess.  Oh well.

Food good, queso good, place clean. 10/10 would come again. It says I need to rite more words but I'm not gonna do that cause I said what I said. Happy to hear the chickens are locally sourced and the queso squeezed fresh every day. Ps ps the pumpkin soft serve is
Great local place. Portions are nice size. Service is attentive.  It's not Casa Vasca in Newark but it gets the job done when you are craving Spanish food.

This place is spectacular with an authenticity and attention to detail that not only ensures good food & drink and a great visit, but really gives you a taste of a wonderful and exotic place!  The native coffee and teas transport you to the land synonymous with coffee and specialty teas, and the cuisine is cultural tour de force.  And the desserts will not disappoint!
I hear they are getting a food truck, so be on the lookout  as this Geist area treasure might be on its way to you!

This is a historical place. There are tons of memories all around the walls. The staff is friendly, attentive, and the food was great. They have a vinegar on the tables that's sooo good I had to buy a bottle to take home. The smoked sausage is like something I never tasted. It was soooo good
New to East Nashville and visited here with our friends. They were vegan and the kitchen took special care of our friends. My Amberjack fish was amazing. Highly recommend this spot!
Love this local place. Sweet employees. Ordered the chai and a hot coffee with vanilla. Will be back to try the food, a great variety!

During quarantine dining we're trying to support all our local establishments.....

Got take out the other night and was awesome.   The grilled cheese sandwich with hand cut fries is great.   Also recommend the portobello burger.   And don't pass up a chance to get the black and blue nachos, da bomb.    And even as take out food it survived the time to get home.   Oh and they were giving a roll of TP too, I know right!

During this virus quarantine,  we like an excuse to drive a goodly distance to pick up food. Sometimes it does cause a slight deterioration in quality, but we just do like being out in the car. So, the other day we drove twenty-five minutes to check out this bar/barbecue in a KOA campground. It did remind me of Texas, especially in the interior dreariness. The food was decent, but not great; certainly not worthy of driving that distance. The meatloaf was tasty but overdone and a bit dry. The brisket was really good. The onion rings did suffer from the drive, but were certainly in the acceptable range. The chicken wings (sticky) were quite good. If we were on that side of town, I'd return. More to the  point, if you are RVing through the Tucson area and want a good place to stop where people seem to be having fun and where you can get some decent chow without cooking, this is certainly a destination.

This was our first time here. We waited outside for 20-30 minutes but fortunately it was warm and sunny. The atmosphere is loud and just like you're at memaws house for a family meal. Ever single thing we ate for breakfast was spot on. The biscuits were the best I've ever had. Come hungry though-it's all you can eat!

I don't understand all of the negative reviews. This is my go-to Chinese spot right now. Very large portions for a small price and the food is really good in my opinion. I usually go for the General Tsos and it comes with free pork fried rice, soup and a side (eggroll). I often eat half for lunch and bring the other half home for dinner. It's a very solid meal and I tend to come here once every week or two. It's not some very high-scale spot but the people are friendly and the food is pretty good!
Food is mediocre at best. Staff is rude every single person that works there has an attitude
I love this place. The people are nice and the food is good. The tamales are to die for. Please visit because you will not be disappointed!
Love the restaurant itself, but DON'T ORDER DELIVERY THROUGH YELP. They waited 45 minutes after we ordered and received a confirmation to let us know they closed and cancelled our order.

Ok, came for a late (2pm) lunch.  Not real busy.  My wife ordered the 8oz steak and was very pleased with the steak and sides.  No complaints. 
On the other hand, I ordered a plain and simple hamburger.  Asked for pink in the middle and it came to me as very well done...very dry. 2nd burger was not much better, but I ate it anyway even though they offered to make me a 3rd.  

Service was ok, but did not like to see the staff ( as many as 3 of them) hanging out at a table near the front that was closed off.  Seems like they have a good policy in place if ever inspected, but it's just a policy, and not the way it is.  Guess that's the problem with corporate restaurants and businesses- they never care as much as local mom and pops do.  In the end, they did not charge me for my burger, hats off to the mgr.

This used to be our favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara. We went there in February 2020 after it was purchased by new owners. In short, it should no longer be called the Paradise Cafe as it bears no resemblance to the original restaurant. The food was mediocre. We ordered a salad which came undressed, looked like it had been prepared by a child, and had no flavor and a tiny piece of salmon. It as listed as an entree but was more like an appetizer portion. Burgers, which used to be fabulous, now taste terrible, with poor quality meat and fries so bad my kids would not eat them. A fried chicken appetizer was unedible.  This used to be a fantastic restaurant, with genuinely good food and wonderful service, in a laid back atmosphere. They've kept the name and nothing else. The food now tastes like something you could get at a college cafeteria or out of a Cisco-supplied chain restaurant. What a loss for Santa Barbara.

Pancakes here were amazing and I'm so glad yelp & google reviews convinced me to try this place. Definitely a gem. I had sweet potato pancakes, 4 buttermilk pancakes, egg white omelet, and hashbrowns. Great pre workout and glad I came on a Wednesday morning......I WILL BE BACK next time I'm in Nashville

We stopped and were nicely surprised by the selection of items. Since we weren't going home for a bit I didn't get as many items as I would of. Of course we will come back with an ice chest and a bigger order!

We got a selection of pork buns, almond cookies, and cashew cookies.

Oh my, the almond cookies were really buttery, and lots of small diced almonds. I ate two in the car!

So glad they are open. 

Update 4/14/19:
I was craving dim sum, and wanted to surprise the hubby.. actually he may faint (62.00 without the almond cookies I ordered last minute)...but he's been busy working on the weekends, so I wanted to show a little love... a big order of love.. ( not including I had to stop and pick up cooked jasmine rice (my short grain rice at home would not work), plus have to incorporate veggies... garlic asparagus... 

We will have lots of leftovers and I can always freeze the buns!

Pros and cons of living out of the realm of Asian restaurants, but I figure it's still cheaper than when we used to drive to Sf to get dim sum!

I was brought To Go gumbo and it was delicious. Full of meat, nice and thick broth and flavorful. It was on the thicker side for a soup. The only thing I would improve upon is the spice factor. I like a little zip in my food, not a ton, just enough. There is a difference between adding it after the fact and during the cooking process. Letting it simmer adds a special level of delicious. I would definitely eat their food again. Can't speak to the ambience as I wasn't there.

I had a great time at 3090 last night!! The band 'Big Easy Brawlers' were soooo #dope! The craft beer selection was cool too! I had a few drafts of 'Art Car'.. they hit the spot! I would definitely go back!

Great place to eat I enjoyed the meal. I will be visiting this restaurant again soon. Staff was friendly price was spot on for the value. The island decor was nice, the flavor of the food was consistent with this type of reaturant

ok i'm sorry but do NOT order any of their entrée bowls, PLEASE. it's just a weird mix of warm veggies that don't go together and the aftertaste was so bad that i literally could not bear to eat more than 2 tiny forkfuls. 

i only give two stars because the cheese board was decent and our server noticed how i just could not eat their squash bowls and kindly took it off the bill for me without me asking; very touched by their considerate customer service! i would give our sever a 5/5 but the FOOD was just not good.

All the El Charro restaurants serve delicious food in spaces with fun, unique ambience, and Charro Vida is no exception. My immediate impression of the restaurant was bright and cheerful, with blue and gold guess complemented by potted succulents. It feels comfortable and homey for a relaxing meal. 

We began our dinner with the Padrón y Pastor: a plate of roasted brussel sprouts and cauliflower. The brussel sprouts are tossed in balsamic vinegar, while the cauliflower is in a wonderfully spicy Chile sauce with large chunks of pineapple. The flavors match well, as the slight acidity of the brussels cuts through the cauliflower when it threatened to get overly unctuous. This plate is huge -- even sharing it between three people felt like a lot! It's so delicious, though, that in my opinion it's a must-order. 

For our entrees, both my companions got the Combo #1, which is a jackfruit carnitas soft taco, a vegan queso enchilada, beans, and rice. While it was good, it didn't quite live up to the expectation set by the appetizer. It didn't burst with flavor the way the brussel sprouts and cauliflower had, and one of my companions kept returning to the appetizer in between bites of his entree. 

I got the Salmon de la Costa: grilled salmon topped with chimichurri and pepitas, served with brussel sprouts and hummus. While the salmon was excellent -- the chimichurri was fabulous, and the pepitas gave it a texturally interesting crunch -- the hummus felt very out of place on the plat

My fiancé and I ordered regular fried wings, fried fish and shrimps, their honey wings and the sides we ordered were Mac n cheese (chick fil a's Mac n cheese taste 99.9% better), sweet potatoes, green beans and cabbage! The color of the cabbage was green, as if it was seasoned with curry, but the taste was super bland. The green beans were crunchy but didn't taste fresh. The sauce on the honey wings did taste good, but the actual wings were large wings, if u like large wings. The bread that was given with the fish platter was stale. Last but not least it smelled. They are located next to a taco Mexican restaurant, maybe the Mexican restaurant smelled...idk... but I definitely wouldn't order from there again! For them to be black owners serving soul food out of boxes and cans, I am disappointed. The shrimps weren't even authentic...they need Robert Irvine from restaurant impossible to come in and give this restaurant life....because it's dying. Maybe the owners lost their inspiration. Or maybe the food tasted like that all along! Either way, these are my thoughts and what I've been thinking!
Giving it 3 stars because the pizza is amazing, but the customer service is SO BAD. They will take calls in the middle of your ordering. Service was slow.

Really great! My boyfriend and I went here for the first time and it was really good!! Ordered the chicken karaage and it was soft (idk if that was the intention) but it was good! My bf ordered the beef teriyaki rice bowl and I ordered the katsudon chicken rice bowl. I recommend !! Would come back here again

I really wanted to love it here because I love that waterside tropical vibe. 

Seriously though, our server was horrible. I called her once in which she saw me and went to another table and never came back to me. Then my husband called her and she Ignored him. Then again he asked for a menu and she said she is  busy. Then she finally came with a menu. I felt like I had to tip toe with her. She was not friendly could not say hi or anything. I know she was overwhelmed but don't be rude and mean. At the end, someone came really nicely and said she would takeover our table, but that's when we were ready to leave.

I had tuna tartare which was alright. The lobster bisque was out. Our drinks were okay, but mine didn't taste  like alcohol even though they said it was in there.

The view is beautiful and there were dogs around so we were happy with that.

I know I wont be back though. From the looks of the reviews, service is a big issue.  If I am back in the area, I will go to Hula Bay instead!

I was so excited to try this place out during my business trip to Philadelphia. I ended up going the day I was due to fly out and am glad I gave it a go. When I got there right as they'd opened. There were already 10 people in line, which didn't surprise me at all. I got several of the pastries - including the pistachio sticky bun and the chocolate rugelach - and also the grilled cheese Jerusalem bagel which had cheese and roasted tomatoes. The sticky bun was just ok. I like the idea of pistachios instead of pecans or other nuts but I don't think it was outstanding compared to other sticky buns. It was a bit dry and didn't have a distinctive taste that would make me want to eat it again. The rugelach, on the other hand, was delicious and a perfect bite of heaven. It was so fresh and each layer was filled with the right amount of chocolate. The bagel was pretty tasty as well. It didn't have a lot of filling which was a bummer but for what it has, it was very good. The tomatoes were like sun dried and very tasty. Overall, it's a good bakery that I would recommend for breakfast or a snack. I don't know if I would stand in a long line for it though. The line had tripled by the time I got my bagel to go and it was only 8:30am. That speaks volumes more than my review I guess.
Good sushi. Super super super easy to order online. Pick your sushi, pay online, it's ready when you arrive. What could be more perfect than that? Especially during these times. Highly recommend!

UPDATED: Changing my rating from 5 stars to four:
My next visit was not nearly as pleasant. I ordered the Almond Butter toast with Strawberries and Bananas, and got home to find that there was not a single strawberry to be found on the toast, but rather was coated in pecans and blueberries, which I have an allergy to. I wish the staff had told me they were replacing the ingredients so that I could have changed my selection. 

Went here for the first time today and it was delicious! Skeptical paying $8 for toast but worth each penny! The portion sizes were great and both varietals were very tasty (we ordered the Everything Avocado as well as the Sunshine caprese). Coffee was great too and they offer free pineapple infused water. Service was quick and friendly, we'll be back soon!

.

When we arrived we were asked if we had a reservation. The hosted acted like it was a big deal that we didn't and started checking if there was room to fit us in. At this point the place wasn't even half full. The hosted then sat us in the bar area and we were ok with that, thinking since we didn't have a reservation they were fitting us in. After about 30 minutes I realized that was probably not the case. The waitress, although friendly, very inattentive. Couldn't get refills quickly or she would forget. Even paying the check was a problem. I had to call over the hostess to take it. When we left I looked around  in both dining rooms to observe there was hardly anyone there. All we wanted was to have is a relaxing dinner and since we "didn't have a reservation " in a half empty restaurant, we were sat in the noisy bar area. Offensive!

Honestly best service and experience we had in Nashville. Being a bachelor party of 20 was not always easy but the Nashville paLace was the sweetest! Very accommodating and food was excellent. It was not very busy during the day on Thursday when we went but we got to listen to live music and sit on their patio in the sun. Highly recommend.
Went for lunch on a Thursday for my husbands birthday. Everything was great. Waitress was attentive and as soon as we needed more meat it was readily available.
